description: This file defines an asynchronous helper function 'waitUntil' that waits for a specified condition to become true within a timeout period. It also defines a custom error type 'AsyncWaitTimeoutError' used when the timeout expires.

classes.name: AsyncWaitTimeoutError
classes.description: Error type indicating a timeout occurred while waiting for a condition.

methods.name: waitUntil
methods.description: Asynchronously waits until a given condition returns true or the timeout expires.
